jobs.title: Hazardous Materials Truck Driver
jobs.description:
Class A Driver (Safety-Focused)

Responsible for transporting hazardous and non-hazardous materials for environmental and industrial services across North America. Ensure strict compliance with DOT, OSHA, and all company safety standards while supporting environmental protection.

Key Duties

Perform pre-trip and post-trip inspections and maintain equipment in safe operating condition
Transport materials in compliance with all applicable regulations
Maintain accurate logs and required manifests
Load and unload drums and bulk waste safely and correctly
Follow spill-response procedures and use required PPE

Qualifications / Skills

Valid Class A CDL
Strong knowledge of DOT and OSHA compliance requirements
Ability to safely handle hazardous/non-hazardous materials
Attention to detail for documentation (logs, manifests) and inspections
Commitment to safety, PPE, and spill-prevention practices

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Industries
